zh: 假期结束了，明天就要开工了。
en: The holiday is over. We go back to work tomorrow.

zh: 接下来到过年呢，我有10个看好的AI生意。
en: From now until the New Year, I see ten promising AI businesses.

zh: 从今天起我们一起见证，看谁先拿到结果。
en: Starting today, let's watch together and see who gets results first.

zh: 想创业或者是想做点副业的。
en: If you want to start a business or try a side job,

zh: 还有你以前做过的工作，可能都用得上。
en: even the work you used to do may come in handy.

zh: 第一，AI agent落地服务商。
en: First: AI Agent implementation services.

zh: 目前95%的中小企业呢，就算装上了agent也根本不会用。
en: Right now, 95% of SMEs can't use an Agent, even after installing it.

zh: 尤其是咱们这个三线城市啊。
en: Especially here, in a third-tier city,

zh: 机会就在安装，调试，行业定制。
en: The opportunity: setup, debugging, and industry customization.

zh: 帮企业把通用的agent，改成可以直接干活的业务助手。
en: Help firms turn a generic Agent into a business assistant that can do real work.

zh: 按月去收取服务费。
en: Charge a service fee each month.

zh: 第二垂直行业数据集生产。
en: Second: producing datasets for vertical industries.

zh: 目前市面上豆包工作，WorkBuddy还有Codex。
en: Right now there is Doubao Work, WorkBuddy, and Codex,

zh: 这些通用模型已经非常多了。
en: Such generic models already abound.

zh: 但是想要模型真正的在家装医疗，还有宠物设备维修。
en: But to get models truly working in home renovation, medical care, pets, and equipment repair,

zh: 这些细分的场景用好。
en: to work well in these specialized settings,

zh: 靠的是这些行业高质量的行业数据。
en: you need this industry data: high-quality industry data.

zh: 做数据清洗标注结构化。
en: Clean, label, and structure data.

zh: 这就是AI时代卖水人的事。
en: This is the 'selling water' work of the AI era.

zh: 第三，AI内容反同质化服务。
en: Third: AI content differentiation services.

zh: 现在就是89%的创作者。
en: Now, 89% of creators

zh: 都在用AI内容同质化越来越严重。
en: use AI, and content is becoming increasingly alike.

zh: 真正稀缺的是真实的信息差。
en: Truly scarce: real informational advantage,

zh: 个人观点和原始数据。
en: personal opinions, and original data.

zh: 机会不是简单的AI代写。
en: The opportunity is not simply AI ghostwriting.

zh: 而是AI初稿加上人工深度的二创的内容服务。
en: It is an AI first draft, plus in-depth human re-creation, as a content service.

zh: 第四，AI设备的最后一公里。
en: Fourth: the last mile for AI equipment.

zh: AIPC，AI显卡。
en: AI PCs and AI graphics cards:

zh: 这些硬件现在在爆发式的增长。
en: this hardware is now growing explosively.

zh: 但是很多传统行业的客户，不会选不会配，买回去也不会用。
en: But many traditional-industry clients can't choose, configure, or use it after buying it.

zh: 咱们把硬件软件配置，培训，打包交付。
en: We bundle hardware, software, configuration, and training into one delivery,

zh: 赚信息差和服务费。
en: Income from info gaps and service fees.

zh: 第五，银发族AI陪伴与生活服务。
en: Fifth: AI companionship and everyday services for seniors.

zh: 老人想预约办事，找人跑腿，交给费用。
en: Seniors want to book services, find errand help, and hand over fees,

zh: 或者是想找人聊聊天。
en: or just find someone to chat with.

zh: 可以做AI问诊，导诊。
en: You can offer AI consultations and care navigation,

zh: 代办跑腿，防诈，骗提醒语音陪伴。
en: errand services, fraud alerts, and voice companionship.

zh: 还有人生回忆录，坐下来听老人讲，把原声老照片留下。
en: And life memoirs: listen to elders, and save their original voices and old photos.

zh: AI辅助整理，然后家人帮着一起去核对。
en: Let AI help organize them, then let family members help check them together.

zh: 做成数字档案，也印成一本书。
en: Make a digital archive, and print a book as well.

zh: 以后翻到某一页的话，扫码就能听到老人当时的声音。
en: Later, scan a page to hear the elder's voice from that time.

zh: 甚至经老人和家人的同意，把这个入口留在墓碑上。
en: Even leave this link on a gravestone, with the elder's and family's consent.

zh: 这个市场需求长期存在。
en: Demand for this market exists over the long term.

zh: 竞争比年轻人的赛道小很多。
en: Far less competition than youth-focused markets.

zh: 第六，AI原生的组织咨询服务。
en: Sixth: AI-native organizational consulting services.

zh: 这一项适合本来就懂企业管理的人。
en: This suits people who already understand business management.

zh: 很多企业知道AI可以提效。
en: Many companies know that AI can improve efficiency,

zh: 但岗位设计流程绩效体系，还停留在工业时代。
en: but job design, processes, and performance systems remain in the industrial era.

zh: 机会就是重新设计人加AI的岗位体系。
en: The opportunity is to redesign job systems built around people plus AI,

zh: 决策流程和考核方式，帮企业完成组织升级。
en: decision processes, and assessment methods, helping companies upgrade their organizations.

zh: 收的是组织诊断和实施辅导的钱。
en: You charge for organizational diagnosis and implementation coaching.

zh: 比装一套软件要深入的多。
en: That goes much deeper than installing a piece of software.

zh: 第七呢，GEO代运营。
en: Seventh: managed GEO operations.

zh: 顾客问AI哪家产品适合我。
en: A customer asks AI, 'Whose product suits me?'

zh: 企业有没有可靠的资料，能够被查到被引用。
en: Does the company have reliable material that can be found and cited?

zh: 核心就是结构化的内容建设，权威信源布局。
en: The core is structured content and positioning authoritative sources.

zh: 做好AI搜索的优化。
en: Optimize for AI search.

zh: 这才是代运营要长期干的话。
en: This is the talk managed operations must keep up over time.

zh: 第八呢，AI时代的数据资产中介。
en: Eighth: data asset intermediaries in the AI era.

zh: 这一项跟前面的数据集生产不一样。
en: This is not the same as the earlier dataset work.

zh: 前面是把数据集加工好。
en: Earlier, we processed datasets properly.

zh: 这里是训练数据，行为数据，创作数据。
en: Here, it is training data, behavioral data, and creative data.

zh: 现在都可以变成资产。
en: These can now all become assets.

zh: 但是绝大数的企业，他不知道怎么去整理，而授权变现。
en: But the vast number of companies do not know how to organize, authorize, or monetize it.

zh: 机会就是做数据资产经理人。
en: The opportunity is to become a data asset manager.

zh: 靠服务费佣金来赚钱。
en: Earn from service fees and commissions.

zh: 第九，产业带AI改造包工头。
en: Ninth: AI retrofit contractors for industrial clusters.

zh: 国内有大量的实体产业带。
en: China has many physical industrial clusters.

zh: 重AI公司不懂实体产业。
en: AI-heavy firms do not understand real industries.

zh: 产业老板又不懂A。
en: And industry owners don't know A.

zh: 吃透一整个产业带。
en: Master an entire industrial cluster.

zh: 把AI装进选品库存客服跟单，这些业务环节赚取改造费。
en: Put AI into product selection, inventory, service, and order tracking, earning retrofit fees,

zh: 加上业务分成。
en: plus a share of the business.

zh: 第十 人机协作技能培训。
en: Tenth: human–AI collaboration skills training.

zh: 教人如何和AI跑通完整的业务流程。
en: Teach people to complete an end-to-end business workflow with AI.

zh: 比如选品内容客服交付这种，结果导向的工作流程培训。
en: Result-oriented workflow training: product selection, content, service, and delivery.

zh: 哪些AI工具擅长什么。
en: What are different AI tools good at?

zh: 如何嵌入到他们自己的工作当中。
en: How do they fit into people's own work?

zh: 把这些具体的方法做成可复用的课件。
en: Make these concrete methods into reusable teaching materials.

zh: 这才是企业真正需求的培训。
en: This is training enterprises genuinely need.

zh: 你对哪一项有兴趣，可以带着你原来做的行业来聊。
en: If any one interests you, come talk about your previous industry.

zh: 我们看看你的经验能用到哪一步。
en: Let's see where your experience can help.

zh: 缺的能力怎么补，再决定要不要做。
en: How to fill skill gaps, then whether to do it.

zh: 还有呢，就是想了解这十个生意具体怎么起步的。
en: And if you want to know how to start these ten businesses,

zh: 可以在评论区留个AI生意。
en: leave 'AI business' in the comments.

zh: 我把整理的入门资料免费分享给大家。
en: I'll share my compiled starter material with everyone for free.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州，和阿祝。
en: I'm Chao Ge, in Lanzhou; 'he a zhu'.
